purpose: Hard pre-live gate registry for WF18 (Telegram gateway). While any P0/P1 item is unresolved, tools/wf18_activation_gate.js REFUSES to let deploy publish/activate WF18. These are the WF18-rearchitecture blockers handed off to the next focused session; resolving each requires real code + a regression test, then flip status to 'resolved' with the proving test named in `evidence`.

blockers.title: no public HTTPS webhook URL / ingress
MS_ENABLE_TELEGRAM kill switch not enforced before side effects
unauthorized updates still read/write private Sheets
duplicate updates still persist rows / change state
approval keyboard defined but not wired to real request id
bot claims actions the workflow did not perform
stale/expired approval callbacks may execute old plans
WF18 does not call WF19/WF20 (no plan->approval->orchestrate path)
WF19/WF20/WF21/WF22 not callable from the gateway where required
capability registry not connected to a real dispatcher
intake state transition result not used (event vs state disagree)
no durable once-only marker for approval/orchestrator dispatch
existing conversation state overwritten instead of patched
nested payload passed to autoMapInputData (no shaping nodes)
